facts.text: Cottey College is an independent women's college owned and supported by the P.E.O. Sisterhood, where students live in 10- to 12-person residential suites and participate in a college-funded international travel experience.

sources.title: Why Cottey - Cottey College
sources.quote: Cottey is also owned by the P.E.O. Sisterhood, an organization of over 200,000 women, who support students as they grow into the leaders they want to be!
